pitch_routes.genre: All network TV factual genres (documentaries, history, science, natural history, religion & ethics, arts & classical music, current affairs incl. Panorama, popular music, factual entertainment, BBC Three)
pitch_routes.route: PiCoS ideas submission system - all ideas must be submitted via PiCoS to the named genre commissioners; for UK production companies with a qualifying commission in the last 3 years (BBC Pitch is closed)
Published support address picos.support@bbc.co.uk (system support only, not for pitching)
Factual acquisition online submission system; BBC says it cannot track submissions sent to individual email addresses

pitch_routes.genre: Supply/business questions (smaller or out-of-London indies) - not content
pitch_routes.route: Contact Lucy Willmore, Commissioning Supply Executive, via contact form
Skills and training pages (individuals cannot use PiCoS)

briefs.title: Documentary commissioning brief
briefs.summary: Narrative/character-driven docs; returnable mainstream access series (4-10 eps) and 'next precinct beyond blue flashing lights'; limited series/box sets; high-impact single films (60 min or feature); BBC Three 30-45 min box sets; new No Filter (w/t) iPlayer strand for younger audiences, topical, 15-40 min forms; nations portrayal; new directors; co-pros welcome

briefs.title: Current affairs commissioning brief
briefs.summary: Panorama: ambitious investigative revelation (pitch to Adam Grimley via PiCoS); BBC Two/iPlayer series and singles with strong title/image and news-making potential, YouTube spin-offs; BBC Three single-narrative stories from last five years with original journalism for 16-34s

briefs.title: Factual homepage (Director of Factual statement)
briefs.summary: All pitches must have iPlayer baked in, with a strong title and thumbnail vision; ideas taken from indies at any time

briefs.title: History / Science / Natural history / Religion and ethics briefs
briefs.summary: Specialist factual genre briefs with team lists; all via PiCoS

briefs.title: Arts and classical music brief
briefs.summary: First points of contact: Mark Bell (singles BBC One/Two, landmarks), Alistair Pegg (box sets/formats/limited series BBC Two), Stephen James-Yeoman (classical music, Arts Digital), David Harron (Scotland), Julian Carey (Wales)

briefs.title: Storyville expands to premium shorts
briefs.summary: Storyville seeking 10-40 minute short documentaries for BBC Four and iPlayer exploring issues shaping the world; new talent encouraged

briefs.title: New pan-UK commissioning model
briefs.summary: Nations commissioners (NI, Scotland, Wales) responsible for ideas with strong on-screen nations portrayal and are key contact for indies in their nation; joint sign-off with genre head; aim for titles made in the place they portray

briefs.title: YouTube deepwatch channel brief
briefs.summary: 20 standalone YouTube-first docs (min 25 min, GBP 50k tariff) for 16-24s, from nations/English-regions indies; deadline 7 May 2026 (closed)

briefs.title: New Entertainment commissioning structure
briefs.summary: Factual Entertainment & Events genre to close in autumn 2026; replaced by Studio Entertainment, Constructed Reality, and Features and Events under Ed Havard
